segments.title: How long does SUNLIGHT take to reach us?
segments.say: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth? Comment your answer. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 8 minutes!
segments.say: About eight minutes and twenty seconds!

segments.title: You see the Sun's PAST
segments.say: So the Sun you see is the Sun from eight minutes ago.

segments.title: Light is that FAST
segments.say: And it still crosses about a hundred and fifty million kilometers to get here.

segments.sub: Comment your answer · tomorrow's is harder
segments.say: Comment your answer, then follow: tomorrow's is harder.
